name: Domri Rade
description: A planeswalker with an affinity for wild creatures, which he summons, commands and enhances; leader of the Gruul on Ravnica.

description_citations.text: "Domri Rade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At Bolas's urging Domri Rade defeats Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on him; Borborygmos loses the Gruul's respect.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Domri Rade challenged and defeated the aging Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on the cyclops

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri Rade ascends as guildleader and the time of the End-Raze is thought to have come.
timeline.quote: the ascension of Domri Rade as guildleader

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The End-Raze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's plan nears fruition; Kaya and Dovin usurp the Orzhov and Azorius while Vraska, Domri and Ral fall under his sway.
timeline.quote: allowing for non-native planeswalkers Kaya Cassir and Dovin Baan to usurp control

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri hurls a stone through the cathedral's Orzhov window, and the friends make glass daggers.
timeline.quote: let the stone fly

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri proposes calling their tribe the Shard Blades.
timeline.quote: We could call our tribe the Shard Blades,

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Walking back to camp, the friends discuss the coming Burying, which fills Domri with dread.
timeline.quote: I wonder what it's going to be like? You know, the Burying.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri is dressed in burial garb and the tribe wails as if he had died; Sabast says the boy dies today.
timeline.quote: In one way or another, that boy dies today.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sabast leads Domri deep into the Utvara and explains the Gruul view of death and nature.
timeline.quote: Look how nature responds,

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sabast leads Domri through a hidden cave to a grave and declares it time for the false Domri to die and the real one to be born.
timeline.quote: It is time for the false you to die.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Orphaned on Ravnica, Domri is too small for any Gruul clan to claim him and befriends feral beasts.
timeline.quote: he was too small and wiry for any clan of the Gruul to claim him

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Joining the Gruul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri commands ragebeasts to drive the Orzhov out of the Rubblebelt; Borborygmos makes him an honorary Burning Tree member.
timeline.quote: The cyclops declared Domri an honorary member of the Burning Tree clan.

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Joining the Gruul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Buried alive in the Gruul rite of passage at Utvara, Domri panics and his eyes are opened.
timeline.quote: It was then, in the darkness, that his eyes were opened.

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Rite of Passage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri wakes on Naya, nearly gets killed by a Gargantuan, is saved by Cylian godtrackers and returns home through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: he was pulled once more through the Blind Eternities to his homeworld

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Rite of Passage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri is buried in the ceremonial grave by Sabast, who chants protection over him.
timeline.quote: the shaman Sabast laid him in the ceremonial grave.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Isolated in the dark, Domri's fear grows and he begs the Old Gods for deliverance.
timeline.quote: He knew the Old Gods were a myth—something the elders believed in.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In a panic, Domri's spark ignites and he Planeswalks for the first time, seeing the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: He shot out into the Multiverse to behold the infinite void of the Blind Eternities.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri awakens in a primordial rainforest with no buildings and is overjoyed.
timeline.quote: He was deep within a primordial rainforest

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri whoops in exultation, drawing a monster; three elves flee past him, calling him an idiot.
timeline.quote: Darting past him came three elves in strange garb

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri runs from a huge creature and is pulled into a cave by the elves.
timeline.quote: two hands shot out, grabbed him, and pulled him into a dark cave.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri tells the elves of Ravnica; Hasal concludes he is out of his head and says their anima will wish to talk to him.
timeline.quote: Our anima will wish to talk to you.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thinking of the Rubblebelt, Domri feels a rush of mana and Planeswalks back through the Blind Eternities to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: And then, in a sickening lurch of unbelievable power, he shot out into the Blind Eternities once more.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri sneaks across Ravnica at midnight back to the Rubblebelt camp.
timeline.quote: The streets of Ravnica at midnight can be a confusing place

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gruul warriors Murgul and Nasri confront Domri and are shocked he is out of the grave.
timeline.quote: "Impossible," Murgul said. "You should still be in the grave."

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri refuses to tell Sabast what happened, expecting banishment.
timeline.quote: "I can't tell you what happened," Domri said, looking at his feet.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sabast refuses to banish Domri and tells him the Gruul have no laws but those of the wild.
timeline.quote: "I'm not going to banish you," Sabast said as he grabbed Domri's arm.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri embraces Sabast and resolves to return to the jungle realm.
timeline.quote: In a rare flood of emotion, Domri embraced the old man.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: During the Burying at Utvara, Domri's spark ignites and sends him to Alara; on return, Sabast declares he passed.
timeline.quote: The stress of the experience caused his planeswalker spark to ignite

citation.text: "Rubblebelt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri calls on people to defy the guilds' promises of obedience and safety.
timeline.quote: And we will not obey.

citation.text: Street Riot (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Domri Rade calls for the city to be smashed to pieces.
timeline.quote: Smash this city to pieces.

citation.text: End-Raze Forerunners (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dovin ticks off the planeswalkers on Ravnica: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska and Bolas.
timeline.quote: Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers

citation.text: Dovin's Acuity (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Domri's ascent is seen by some as a sign of Ilharg's return.
timeline.quote: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

citation.text: Rhythm of the Wild (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Domri says no peace accord will save Ravnica and it must be burned down.
timeline.quote: No peace accord will save Ravnica.

citation.text: Gravel-Hide Goblin (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With Bolas's help Domri defeats Borborygmos and becomes Gruul guildmaster.
timeline.quote: becoming the guildmaster by defeating the cyclops Borborygmos

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri leads the Gruul in a mob rampage to push the guilds into chaos.
timeline.quote: Domri led the Gruul in a concerted effort to tip the world into chaos

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: About 60 years later, Domri Rade performs the Burying in Utvara; the stress ignites his spark and sends him to Alara.
timeline.quote: The stress of the experience caused his planeswalker spark to ignite, sending him to Alara from inside the sarcophagus he was buried in.

citation.text: "Utvara Valley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri realizes what kind of master he has served as an Eternal's hand tightens on his throat.
timeline.quote: Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

citation.text: Soul Diviner (War of the Spark Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Elderspell harvests Domri's spark to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.
timeline.quote: With the harvest of Domri's spark, the Elderspell began to fuel Bolas's ascension to godhood.

citation.text: Spark Harvest (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An Eternal's cold fingers tighten on Domri's throat as he realizes what kind of master he served.
timeline.quote: As the Eternal's cold fingers tightened around his throat, Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

citation.text: Soul Diviner (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Domri first fights the Eternals and helps save Kaya, then sides with Bolas after seeing him topple the Vitu-Ghazi elemental.
timeline.quote: even helped save Kaya in a tight spot

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Elderspell harvests Domri's spark, draining all the moisture in his body.
timeline.quote: All the moisture in his body was drained.

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark and Domri's death, Borborygmos becomes acting guildmaster again.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos became acting guildmaster again.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri Rade leads the Gruul in an effort to tip the world into chaos.
timeline.quote: Domri Rade led the Gruul in a concerted effort to tip the world into chaos.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark Domri Rade leads the Gruul in a mob rampage through the Tenth District.
timeline.quote: Domri Rade led the Gruul in a massive mob rampage through the city streets of the Tenth District, causing destruction and chaos to keep the guilds at each other's throats.

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas conspires to replace the guild leaders of Ravnica with planeswalkers he can influence.
timeline.quote: Bolas conspires to overthrow the leaders of Ravnica's guilds and replace them with Planeswalkers that he can influence

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas casts the Elderspell and Domri becomes the first planeswalker drained of his spark and killed.
timeline.quote: Domri, despite pledging his loyalty to Bolas, is the first Planeswalker to be drained of his spark and killed.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gruul warriors led by Domri Rade charge the Eternals from behind and save the trio.
timeline.quote: attacked the Eternals from behind, axes chopping through lazotep.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gruul, Simic and Izzet storm a hill together, and Huatli, Saheeli Rai and Kasmina join; Bombop and a Simic shaman are killed.
timeline.quote: Poor Bombop rushed in too far ahead of the rest of us.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The God-Eternals tear apart Vitu-Ghazi, and Domri cheers and announces the Gruul will join the dragon.
timeline.quote: We're joining the dragon!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gan Shokta refuses to follow Domri and goes back to Borborygmos, and Domri leads others to the plaza.
timeline.quote: I'm going back to Borborygmos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat learns Domri Rade is dead after his Spark was harvested and that Niv-Mizzet is dead.
timeline.quote: Turns out he was a Planeswalker and got his Spark harvested by an Eternal.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ari survives the War of the Spark and joins the new Gruul guild without Domri Rade.
timeline.quote: Ari survived the War of the Spark

citation.text: "Ari Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Bolas's urging, Domri defeats the aging Borborygmos with waves of beasts; he is not killed but loses respect and lives as a Trog in the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Afterward, he lived as a Trog (hermit) in the Rubblebelt.

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri leads the Gruul on Ravnica, reveling in chaos and destruction.
timeline.quote: As leader of the Gruul on Ravnica, Domri revels in chaos and destruction.

citation.text: "Domri Rade". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ferzhin fights Domri Rade, is wounded, and defeats him with a headbutt.
timeline.quote: Despite being wounded by Domri, she defeated him with a headbutt.

citation.text: "Ferzhin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gan denounces Domri after Domri declares an alliance with Nicol Bolas and leaves the group to return to Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: He then left Domri and the group, maintaining his integrity and commitment to his principles.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gan and his family survive the War of the Spark and join the new Gruul Clan freed from Domri.
timeline.quote: Gan and his family survived the War of the Spark and were part of the new Gruul Clan, freed from Domri's leadership.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Govan and Gan Shokta refused to join Domri Rade on the side of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Govan agreed with Gan Shokta in refusing to join Domri Rade on the side of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Govan Radley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hasal, Elishta and Maklo flee a gargantuan and run past Domri Rade, freshly planeswalked.
timeline.quote: They ran past Domri Rade , freshly planeswalked for the first time

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An elf pulls Domri into a cave until the gargantuan passes.
timeline.quote: pulled him into a dark cave until the gargantuan had passed them by

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hasal questions Domri, who describes Ravnica and the Gruul.
timeline.quote: an entire world made of buildings

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri accidentally planeswalks away again, making the elves among the first to witness a planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Domri accidentally planeswalked away again

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri Rade replaces Borborygmos; Ruric Thar resents him and launches raids into the Tenth District.
timeline.quote: They channeled his anger into a series of brutal raids

citation.text: "Ruric Thar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Domri Rade's death at the hands of the Dreadhorde, the Gruul Clans regroup at Skarrg.
timeline.quote: the death of their new guildleader Domri Rade at the hands of the invading Dreadhorde

citation.text: "Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The shaman who tended him, Sabast

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: killed him during the War of the Spark
